name: dsh-steward
description: Steward for DeepSeek Harness: seven role charters injected at dispatch time (no user-selectable agent presets); a per-session right-sidebar team panel that draws each dispatched subagent as a node in a team tree (role, actual model, task, state, elapsed, tokens; click a node for its child session; graph by default, list on demand; artifacts collapsed at the bottom); a task-progress bar counted from the host's own task list (counted, never copied); a Settings → Steward table for per-role model/effort; per-role routes from <project>/steward.config.json over the panel settings; the Agent Teams shared task board as the authoritative task source; four documentation entry skills (docs-new / docs-takeover / docs-feature / docs-review) backed by a hard readiness gate that refuses backend-dev / frontend-dev dispatch until the seven-phase documents pass closure checks and review; and a /steward-roster command.
